plugins.prepareCmd: ./gradlew :patches:buildAndroid generatePatchesList --no-daemon && jq --arg v "${nextRelease.version}" --arg url "https://github.com/${process.env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/releases/download/v${nextRelease.version}/patches-${nextRelease.version}.mpp" --arg created "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)" '.version = $v | .download_url = $url | .created_at = $created' patches-bundle.json > patches-bundle.json.tmp && mv patches-bundle.json.tmp patches-bundle.json
